# Brex — account brief

## Who

Brex offers corporate cards and spend management software for startups and enterprises ([source](https://brex.com/)). Its GitHub org profile lists brex.com and describes a regulated ("financial") category ([source](https://github.com/brexhq)).

## Production Expo signals

- `eas.json` is present in `brexhq/brex-mobile` ([source](https://github.com/brexhq/brex-mobile/blob/main/eas.json)).
- `package.json` pins react-native 0.74.5 ([source](https://github.com/brexhq/brex-mobile/blob/main/package.json)).
- The repo has CI workflows under `.github/workflows` ([source](https://github.com/brexhq/brex-mobile/tree/main/.github/workflows)).
- The org has 27 public repos and 410 followers ([source](https://github.com/brexhq)).
- The Brex iOS app has 28,000 App Store ratings ([source](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/brex/id1472293141)).
- There have been 7 App Store releases in the last 90 days ([source](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/brex/id1472293141)).
- An open issue reads "expo upgrade to SDK 52 blocked by native module mismatch" ([source](https://github.com/brexhq/brex-mobile/issues/87)).

## Who to talk to

- Maintainer One (@brexhq-maintainer-1), 260 commits, top contributor to `brexhq/brex-mobile` ([source](https://github.com/brexhq-maintainer-1)). Profile lists company "Brex", location "Remote", website https://brex.com, and bio "Mobile engineer at Brex. Maintains the Brex mobile app (Expo / React Native)." ([source](https://github.com/brexhq-maintainer-1)).
- Maintainer Two (@brexhq-maintainer-2), 133 commits ([source](https://github.com/brexhq-maintainer-2)). Profile lists company "Brex", location "New York, NY", website https://brex.com, and bio "React Native developer on the Brex mobile team. EAS builds and releases for the Brex mobile app." ([source](https://github.com/brexhq-maintainer-2)).
- @brexhq-maintainer-3, 58 commits ([source](https://github.com/brexhq-maintainer-3)). The evidence does not list a name, company, location, or bio for this profile.

## Why now

`brexhq/brex-mobile` last pushed 2026-08-15 and the app shipped 7 App Store releases in the last 90 days ([source](https://github.com/brexhq/brex-mobile)) ([source](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/brex/id1472293141)). The repo is on react-native 0.74.5 while an open issue tracks an Expo SDK 52 upgrade blocked by a native module mismatch ([source](https://github.com/brexhq/brex-mobile/blob/main/package.json)) ([source](https://github.com/brexhq/brex-mobile/issues/87)).

## Suggested opener

Maintainer One — your profile says you maintain the Brex mobile app on Expo / React Native ([source](https://github.com/brexhq-maintainer-1)). Issue 87 in `brexhq/brex-mobile` says the Expo SDK 52 upgrade is blocked by a native module mismatch, and the repo is still on react-native 0.74.5 ([source](https://github.com/brexhq/brex-mobile/issues/87)) ([source](https://github.com/brexhq/brex-mobile/blob/main/package.json)). With 7 App Store releases in the last 90 days, how are you sequencing that SDK upgrade against your release cadence in the `.github/workflows` builds ([source](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/brex/id1472293141)) ([source](https://github.com/brexhq/brex-mobile/tree/main/.github/workflows))?
